title: sternbergia lutea subsp. greuteriana
intro: Sternbergia lutea subsp. greuteriana, commonly known as the Autumn Sternbergia or Golden Sternbergia, is a plant species in the Amaryllidaceae family. It is a bulbous perennial plant known for its bright yellow flowers and is primarily used in traditional medicine for its health benefits. The plant is believed to have anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties, making it effective in treating various health issues such as wounds, digestive problems, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
